text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Takarazuka Kinen! Yaeno recognizes me as a rival and formidable foe, but says she's still going to win! Wow, talk about motivating words!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Chiyono O called me her rival too! She says her performance today will show me how strongly she wants to achieve her dream!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And as if all that wasn't enough, Inari, the embodiment of Edo, also stepped up to the plate! Can this day get any better?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: This race is super important to my roommate City as well. I really can't wait to go out there and grab first place! Raaah!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I can't believe I've got so many rivals! I'm ready to run with everything I've got!
